nodes.content: Develop retrieval-augmented reasoning that revises multi-hop conclusions under corrected evidence while preserving conclusions unaffected by the correction.
requirements: Improve corrected-answer accuracy by 10 percentage points over standard RAG given identical updated evidence.
Preserve at least 95% of previously correct answers whose supporting evidence remains valid.

nodes.content: Build DeltaTrace RAG: track claim-level evidence dependencies, recompute conclusions affected by corrected passages, and retain verified unaffected reasoning paths.
How can DeltaTrace identify multi-hop claims affected by a corrected passage without invalidating independent supporting paths?
Explicit passage-to-claim dependencies and alternative-support tracking will yield ≥90% affected-claim recall and ≥95% unaffected-answer retention.
Construct DeltaTrace-500 with corrected passages, claim links, and alternative supports; implement selective invalidation and measure affected-claim recall and unaffected-answer retention.
Run DeltaTrace and standard RAG on DeltaTrace-500 with identical corrected passages; score affected-claim recall, unaffected-answer retention, and corrected-answer accuracy.
On DeltaTrace-500, DeltaTrace achieved 92% affected-claim recall, 96% unaffected-answer retention, and 79% corrected-answer accuracy versus RAG's 67%.
Advance DeltaTrace to broader validation: its 12-point corrected-answer gain and 96% unaffected-answer retention meet both targets.
DeltaTrace-500 evaluation report includes paired predictions and scripts reproducing 92% affected-claim recall, 96% unaffected-answer retention, and 79%-versus-67% accuracy.
Using DeltaTrace-500 report scripts, test 100 new alternative-support corrections and measure affected-claim recall and unaffected-answer retention.
On 100 new alternative-support corrections, DeltaTrace reached 83% affected-claim recall, below the hypothesized 90%, despite 96% unaffected-answer retention.
Entailment-checked cross-passage edges will lift alternative-support affected-claim recall from 83% to ≥90% while preserving ≥95% unaffected-answer retention.
Audit missed links, add entailment-checked cross-passage edges, and compare recall and retention against DeltaTrace on 200 held-out corrections.
Using DeltaTrace-500 report scripts, benchmark original and entailment-edge DeltaTrace on 200 held-out corrections for affected-claim recall and unaffected-answer retention.
On 200 held-out mixed corrections, original DeltaTrace achieved 91% affected-claim recall and 96% retention; entailment-edge DeltaTrace achieved 94% and 95%.
Among 80 alternative-support corrections, entailment-edge recall reached 86% versus 83% originally, below the hypothesized 90%.
Defer deployment: the initial 12-point gain and 94% overall recall mask alternative-support recall rising only from 83% to 86%.
Held-out correction audit v1 contains paired predictions, alternative-support error labels, and recall/retention breakdowns for both DeltaTrace variants.
Develop TwinProof RAG: compare pre- and post-correction proof chains, revise contradicted steps, and retain independently reverified conclusions.
Can TwinProof distinguish conclusions needing revision from those still justified by independent proof chains after a passage correction?
TwinProof's paired-chain verification will improve corrected-answer accuracy by ≥10 points over standard RAG while retaining ≥95% valid answers.
Implement paired-chain verification; benchmark TwinProof against standard RAG on TwinProof-300 with identical updated evidence, measuring accuracy and retention.
Run TwinProof and standard RAG on TwinProof-300 with identical updated evidence; score corrected-answer accuracy and valid-answer retention.
On TwinProof-300, corrected-answer accuracy reached 81% versus RAG’s 69% with identical evidence; valid-answer retention was 97%.
Stress-test TwinProof against standard RAG on 120 alternative-support corrections with identical updated evidence; measure corrected-answer accuracy and valid-answer retention.
On 120 alternative-support corrections, TwinProof achieved 76% corrected-answer accuracy versus RAG’s 69%, and 93% valid-answer retention.
Counterfactual chain interventions plus independent-support checks will exceed RAG accuracy by ≥10 points with ≥95% valid-answer retention on alternative-support corrections.
Add counterfactual chain interventions and independent-support checks; retest 120 alternative-support corrections against unchanged TwinProof and RAG baselines.
Implement TwinProof-CF and rerun the 120-case alternative-support test; score corrected-answer accuracy and valid-answer retention against unchanged baselines.
On 120 alternative-support corrections, TwinProof-CF reached 80% accuracy versus RAG’s 69%, with 96% valid-answer retention.
Test TwinProof-CF against RAG on 200 held-out alternative-support corrections with identical updated evidence; score corrected-answer accuracy and valid-answer retention.
On 200 held-out alternative-support corrections, TwinProof-CF scored 77% accuracy versus RAG’s 69%, with 94% valid-answer retention.
Adding calibrated independent-support adjudication to TwinProof-CF will raise held-out accuracy from 77% to ≥79% and retention from 94% to ≥95%.
Calibrate independent-support adjudication on development corrections, then compare TwinProof-CF with RAG on fresh alternative-support cases for accuracy and retention.
Calibrate support adjudication on 100 development cases; benchmark TwinProof-CF and RAG on 250 fresh corrections for accuracy and retention.
On 250 fresh alternative-support corrections, calibrated TwinProof-CF scored 80% accuracy versus RAG’s 68%; valid-answer retention was 96%.
Manual adjudication of the same 250 cases found 77% corrected-answer accuracy and 93% valid-answer retention, below automated scores.
Blind-review scoring disagreements across 250 cases; compare calibrated and uncalibrated TwinProof-CF against RAG on manually scored accuracy and retention.
After correcting disputed labels in 250 cases, calibrated TwinProof-CF scored 79.2% accuracy/95% retention; uncalibrated scored 77%/94%; RAG 68% accuracy.
Advance calibrated TwinProof-CF to replication, not deployment: audited accuracy exceeds RAG by 11.2 points with 95% retention despite scoring discrepancies.
TwinProof-CF audit v2 contains 250 blind-reviewed cases, corrected labels, adjudication rules, and scripts reproducing 79.2% accuracy and 95% retention.
Train ChangeGate RAG with synthetic passage edits, contrastive changed-answer pairs, and a stability loss for unaffected multi-hop answers.
Can ChangeGate learn when an evidence edit changes a multi-hop answer without overreacting to irrelevant edits?
Contrastive edit training plus stability loss will give ChangeGate ≥10-point corrected-answer accuracy gain over RAG and ≥95% valid-answer retention.
Generate paired edits, train ChangeGate with contrastive and stability losses, then benchmark identical updated evidence against standard RAG.
Train ChangeGate using audit v1 error labels and contrastive/stability losses; benchmark fresh corrections against RAG for accuracy and retention.
On ChangeGate-400 fresh corrections, ChangeGate scored 81% corrected-answer accuracy versus RAG’s 69% with identical evidence; valid-answer retention reached 96%.
Using audit v1 error labels, test ChangeGate on 150 new alternative-support and irrelevant edits; compare accuracy and retention with RAG.
On 150 alternative-support and irrelevant edits, ChangeGate scored 74% accuracy versus RAG’s 69%, with 91% valid-answer retention.
Do ChangeGate’s synthetic stability pairs adequately represent edits that leave an alternative support path valid?
Adding verified alternative-support edits to stability training will yield ≥95% retention and ≥10-point accuracy gain over RAG on challenging edits.
Generate verified alternative-support stability pairs, retrain ChangeGate, and evaluate on held-out challenging edits against unchanged RAG.
Use DeltaTrace audit v1 labels and TwinProof-CF audit v2 rules to retrain ChangeGate; benchmark challenging-edit accuracy and retention against RAG.
On 200 challenging edits, audit-trained ChangeGate scored 80% versus RAG’s 69% and retained 96%; original ChangeGate retained 91%.
Advance audit-trained ChangeGate to independent replication, not original ChangeGate: challenging-edit accuracy gained 11 points over RAG with 96% retention.
ChangeGate-AS v1 contains verified alternative-support training pairs, audit-derived labels, retraining configuration, and scripts for the 200-edit evaluation.
Replicate calibrated TwinProof-CF and ChangeGate-AS independently; defer DeltaTrace for alternative-support recall gaps and defer deployment pending validation.
